turns.say: Abeg, wetin be inflation?
turns.reply: Inflation is the rise in the overall price level of goods and services in an economy over time. When inflation is high, each naira buys fewer things than before. It’s usually measured as a percentage change in a consumer‑price index (CPI) from one period to the next. Central banks try to keep inflation at a moderate level because very high inflation erodes purchasing power, while very low or negative inflation (deflation) can signal weak demand.
